title: pneumonanthe triflora
intro: Pneumonanthe triflora, commonly known as Marsh Marigold, is a flowering plant native to Northern Europe and Asia. The Marsh Marigold has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against infections and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Marigold include its ability to act as a diuretic and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Marigold include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
